Class ResourceDistributionRasterExporter

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.export.ResourceDistributionRasterExporter
public final class ResourceDistributionRasterExporter extends Object

Resource Distribution Raster Exporter

Handles cartographic, hydrological, and geological dataset exports in multiple standardized GIS formats:

  • GIS Multi-Format Exports: GeoJSON FeatureCollections, GeoTIFF multi-band metadata, and NetCDF-4 spatiotemporal cube structures.
  • Cryptographic Provenance Manifests: Generates SHA-256 provenance checksum manifests verifying empirical dataset integrity against USGS, IAEA, and UNESCO WHyMAP standards.
  • Raster Image Serialization: PNG / JPEG exports of biomes, hydrography, and 10 lithospheric tensor layers with user-facing dialogs.
  • Equirectangular ESRI WorldFile Rasterization: Generates 2:1 raster planes (2048x1024) coupled with ESRI .tfw / .pgw metadata.
